scripts.build: vpx scripts/env/index.ts api web && turbo run build
scripts.dev: vpx scripts/env/index.ts api web && turbo run dev
scripts.preview: vpx scripts/env/index.ts api web && turbo run preview
scripts.docker:up: vpx scripts/env/index.ts docker && docker buildx version >/dev/null && DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker compose -f compose.yaml up --build -d
scripts.format: turbo run format && prettier --config prettier.config.js --ignore-path .prettierignore --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json vite.config.ts prettier.config.js scripts/env/*.ts scripts/tsconfig.json README.md AGENTS.md .vscode/*.json
scripts.format:check: turbo run format:check && prettier --config prettier.config.js --ignore-path .prettierignore --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json vite.config.ts prettier.config.js scripts/env/*.ts scripts/tsconfig.json README.md AGENTS.md .vscode/*.json
